name: First-Offer Heuristic Anchoring
scenario: Submitting the initial commercial proposal for an enterprise digital transformation initiative.
script: "Based on our architectural discovery and organizational change requirements, the strategic engagement is priced at an initial investment of $750,000 for the foundational implementation."
defense: Reject the anchor: $750,000 is outside allocation; wipe it from the table and price baseline developer-day rates.
originFull: Anchoring-and-Adjustment Heuristic demonstrates that initial numerical values serve as powerful cognitive reference points, pulling subsequent counter-adjustments toward themselves.
defenseFull: When hit with an extreme opening anchor, reject it immediately to prevent cognitive fixation: "We cannot utilize $750,000 as a viable basis for commercial discussion; that figure is entirely outside our strategic allocation. Let us wipe that number from the table and look at baseline developer-day rates."
